Section 4 says to fix the designated primary and to use the fallback hierarchy only if primaries are several or absent. The stricter reading was applied: CEI is the single designated primary, so it is locked, and its k cannot be established. The HbA1c-in-T2D path was not explored, and no supplement was fetched.
